scripts.predev: bun scripts/check-dependencies.mjs && bun scripts/dev-port-guard.mjs && bun scripts/setup-shadcn-ai.mjs && bun scripts/setup-ripgrep.mjs && bun run dev:tools
scripts.build: bun run --workspaces --if-present build && bun scripts/dotnet.mjs build TinadecOffice.slnx
scripts.test: bun run test:scripts && bun run --workspaces --if-present test && bun scripts/dotnet.mjs test TinadecOffice.slnx
scripts.restore:dotnet: bun scripts/dotnet.mjs restore TinadecCore/TinadecCore.slnx && bun scripts/dotnet.mjs restore TinadecOffice.slnx
scripts.diagrams: d2 --layout tala --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/boundary.d2 docs/diagrams/out/boundary.svg && d2 --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/dual-layer.d2 docs/diagrams/out/dual-layer.svg && d2 --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/roadmap.d2 docs/diagrams/out/roadmap.svg
scripts.ai:tools:install: bun install -g @colbymchenry/codegraph && codegraph telemetry off && codegraph install --target=opencode --location=local --yes
scripts.ai:tools:check: bun run ai:codegraph:status && bun run ai:ponytail:validate
